The first two milestones are in place: the search → compare → list baseline (J01–J04, PR #15) and the tracking/alerts/budgets/reminders batch (J05–J08, PR #18). A shopper can now search, compare one exact product, keep a saved list, save a wishlist, track a product, receive in-app alerts, plan a budget, and set restock reminders. The last four jobs have not started, so today the shopper still cannot: - ask a price question and get an answer with a reason (**J0
